nodes.label: Integrations
nodes.rationale: Public API, webhooks and staff single sign-on, configured on Settings, Integrations.

nodes.label: Public API /api/v1
nodes.rationale: A read-only versioned JSON API for other systems, separate from the signed-in /api the React pages use and from the mobile sync API. It is read-only: other methods answer 405. OpenAPI is generated from the route declarations so it never drifts from the code. Keys live in the tenant database, so a key only reads the college it was created in.

nodes.label: API keys and scopes
nodes.rationale: The plaintext key is shown once. Only the prefix and a SHA-256 hash are stored. A key carries the scopes it was created with and cannot gain one later; create another key instead. Scopes are catalog:read, timetable:read, people:read and attendance:read. catalog:read includes subject coverage only while syllabus is on and locked internal marks only while assessments is on. Per-key limit defaults to 600 a minute.

nodes.label: Webhook outbox
nodes.rationale: Triggers write webhook_deliveries inside the transaction that made the change, so a rolled-back change produces no webhook. Events are attendance.marked, timetable.published and attendance.defaulters, the last of which is the notification trigger. Any non-2xx or a timeout retries with growing delay up to 8 attempts. https is required in production. Hosts that resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses are refused unless WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE is set, so an endpoint cannot be pointed at the server's own network. WEBHOOKS_ENABLED false stops the worker; triggers queue nothing when there are no endpoints.

nodes.label: Webhook HMAC signature
nodes.rationale: The endpoint secret is shown once and stored Fernet-encrypted with SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, the same key as SMTP settings. Verify by recomputing HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp and raw body, comparing in constant time, and rejecting timestamps older than five minutes. Use X-Timetable-Delivery to de-duplicate, because a retry re-sends the same id.

nodes.label: OpenID Connect staff sign-in
nodes.rationale: Admins, HODs and teachers can sign in with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID or any OpenID Connect provider. Students keep the password form because their accounts have no verified staff email. The flow is authorization code with PKCE. The id token must be RS256 and is checked for issuer, audience, expiry, issued-at, not-before, nonce and subject. Link-by-email matches exactly one non-student account on a verified email inside the allowed domains. Locked or inactive accounts are refused as they are for passwords.
